summary: Frontend-only regression of the 7HUES homepage POLISH iteration at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Verified every acceptance criterion in the review request on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). Road SVG + motorcycle fully gone (no scroll-motorcycle testid, main is one continuous bg-sand rgb(236,228,214) canvas). Section order after hero is 01 ABOUT (with 4 team members) -> 02 WHAT WE DO (3 points) -> 03 HOW WE DELIVER (4 items in a single balanced desktop row, tops all 3671px, no giant center gap) -> 04 WHY 7HUES (balanced 2-col with image loaded natWidth=1400 + 4 why-items) -> 05 EXPERIENCES (2-col catalogue of 6 cards experience-0..5, staggered md:mt-20 on odd cards, rounded-2xl images, tag+title, NO experiences-cta and no experience-6) -> 06 FROM THE ROAD (3 posts, all <a target=_blank>) -> 07 JOURNAL (3 cards + journal-cta). Hero: hero-eyebrow + hero-book-cta present, play-showreel absent. No broken images (0 images with naturalWidth=0). No console errors, no page errors. Mobile: zero horizontal overflow (scrollW==clientW==390), menu-toggle opens mobile-menu, team grid becomes 2-up (rows share top), experience cards stack 1-up full width. Booking regression: /book form fills, POST /api/bookings -> 200 and booking-success rendered.

issues: The 3-line headline 'NOT JUST A RIDE. AN EXPERIENCE YOU CARRY BACK.' wraps and the last line ('BACK.') visually collides with / sits behind the BOOK YOUR RIDE CTA — the CTA is faintly visible under the last line of text. Consider reducing hero headline size on <=390 breakpoint or adding a top margin/gap before the CTA button.

action_items: (Minor / polish only) Fix mobile hero headline overlapping the BOOK YOUR RIDE CTA at 390px — reduce font-size or add explicit margin between last headline line and the CTA.
critical_code_review_comments: HowWeDeliver items no longer collapse into a 2-column layout on desktop (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4) — good. Verified all 4 tops equal 3671px at 1440 width, so the previous 'huge empty middle' complaint is resolved.

WhyHues uses lg:grid-cols-2 with items-center; on 1440 the image (aspect 4/5) and the 4 points fill both columns — no blank half. Note MaskImage uses feather class which relies on a mask-image; ensure that mask is applied only on md+ if a stronger visual is desired.
Experiences.js uses `i % 2 === 1 ? 'md:mt-20' : ''` for the Lusion stagger — nice, but the odd-column offset means the section's overall bottom padding on mobile is fine (mt-20 only at md+). Good.

FromTheRoad social-post-* anchors correctly use target=_blank; however href points to bare 'https://instagram.com/' / 'https://youtube.com/' (no rel=noopener seen in DOM). Recommend adding rel='noopener noreferrer' to all target=_blank links.
Home.js wraps sections in <main className='bg-sand'> — one continuous cream canvas confirmed (rgb(236,228,214)). Good regression guard.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 14 acceptance checks pass; 1 minor mobile-hero design nit.

seed_data_creation: One TEST_regression booking POSTed via /api/bookings (200) during the regression check.
